text:
priya: Hey team — final round for candidate is Tue 10:00am PT (candidate is CET). Need panel confirmation + debrief scribe. Can folks confirm availability or propose swaps?

samir: I can take the 10am slot. happy to scribe. :+1:

alex: I’m out that morning. Can cover if we move to 11:30 PT.

elena: Can be backup scribe at 10, or take 11:30. prefer 10 if others need 11:30.

maya: Quick rubric Q: do we use the updated `system-design` weightings (60/40 live/takehome) or the legacy split? Asking because candidate has a takehome.

priya: Use the updated rubric — system-design-first. For this candidate: live + behavioral = 60%, takehome = 40%. I’ll paste links in a sec.

people-ops-bot: Calendar invite created and sent to panel; candidate confirmed time (18:00 CET). Recording consent checkbox included.

jordan: Left a short note in the debrief template: please capture 3 bullets: signal, risks, hire/pass. I'll take lead on collecting code review notes asynchronously.

maya: Thanks — on transcriptions: candidate consent OK? we need to confirm before we hit record.

priya: Candidate already consented in intake form (confirmed by @people-ops-bot).

samir: Tiny checklist for the scribe: 
```
- Capture top 3 strengths
- Capture 2 risk areas
- Vote (hire/pass/hold) + short rationale
- Add 1 suggested next step
```

alex: If we move to 11:30 PT, call it out here and I’ll swap my calendar.

elena: noted. If no objections by EOD I'll assume 10:00 PT and samir will scribe.

priya: Thanks all — final: @jordan will aggregate code review notes into the debrief doc asynchronously. I’ll follow up with the post-interview eval link and a reminder 30m before. :rocket:
